ms.report:
Like we had mentioned throughout the application some names and processes might end up being different than what was mentioned in our original submission. This is exactly what has happened! We are still delivering the exact same functionality but have found a different abstraction / model that has better tradeoffs for how we understand the protocol will be used in Cardano.
As it stands, we have introduced an intermediate construct: the "Piggy Bank" which is a separate script address intermediating between the policy holder and the investor. this allowed us to avoid what was appearing to be some duplication in checks between the scripts handled at the policy side and what would have been scripts handled separately at the investment side. With the introduction of the Piggy Bank abstraction, we have a single set of scripts that validates actions from both sides.
We have now written what in essentially the full on-chain suite of contracts. Alongside the full open source codebase for the smart contract suite, the following set of on-chain transactions conforming to the scope of this second Milestone 2!

Additionally a final closeout report and closeout video will be supplied as a section in the gitbooks page. 
The closeout report will contain the conclusions and what was achieved by the project and a link to a brief closeout video, that allow the community to quickly understand the outcomes of the project.
In summary the final outputs will be:
・Updated documentation site with all support documentation up this point
・Command line (cli) executable able to operate all on-chain fida functions.
・Closeout report (as both a separate PDF and section in the updated documentation) as per Catalyst requirements
・Closeout video as per Catalyst requirements explaining everything achieved with the supplied funding.
ms.criteria:

You will be able to use the cli to:
